title: When the Company Bets on a New Product
subtitle: A design function levelled up because it had to be in the room

cv.label: Download CV (PDF)
cv.note: Tailored for the Head of Product Design role

bio.short: I have run a design function outright — capacity, structure, levels, processes — and carried the design system at three companies. The current one enforces itself in the build, so the standard holds without specialist review.
bio.long:
At Datameer the company kept its existing product and its existing business, saw the market shifting, and decided to build a new product for it. What happened to design because of that decision is the part I care about. Research stopped being something we asked permission for and got executive backing. Design moved from executing a roadmap to sitting in the conversation where the roadmap was written.

Our users there were analysts inside banks and insurers, and no vendor was getting into those buildings to watch them work. The standard panels could not reach them either. So I built an iterative screening method on usertesting.com until it did. That is the difference between building a research practice and operating inside one someone else built.

At Ninox the function was mine outright: capacity, allocation, prioritization of work, team structure and processes. A dedicated design team with designers assigned to specific product teams' work — neither a central agency nor fully embedded. I built a levelling framework there covering design and UX writing, which is the part most teams with writers on them never solve, and used it for growth plans so a junior designer and a junior writer could see the path to the next level. Performance reviews, hiring, promotions, and a lean 360 I ran as a workshop rather than a survey.

The design system has been mine at three companies. The current one is the useful reference: Bibel TV's engineering sits at an outside agency and there is no design team to check the work, so the standard had to move into the build. DTCG tokens in four tiers serve iOS, Android, web and connected TV from one source, and checks refuse a hardcoded color or a token that does not resolve, identically on a laptop and in CI. Adoption followed from making the compliant path the fastest one rather than from asking.

context.emphasis: The maturity leap FIRST, with its mechanism: a profitable company betting on a new product generation and pulling design into the decision. The design system second, as the answer to the question their new operating model creates — how does the standard hold once designers are embedded and nobody reviews each screen. Org-building is instrumented rather than intuitive: a levelling framework across two disciplines, growth plans, reviews, a 360 run as a workshop.
